sharedHandlerDependencies.needed: Authoritative memory queries by race, total count, and distinct card name, available to both AUTO conditions and CONT evaluation. The existing top-three-to-memory handler does not provide these queries.

One ordered, private effect that inspects the top seven; chooses/reveals up to two eligible cards; adds one selected revealed card to hand; puts the remaining revealed cards into memory; shuffles the remainder; and commits atomically for either player. No current operation models this sequence.
A continuous Vanguard-circle restriction that enforces two or more simultaneous calls from hand to Guardian Circle when the distinct-name memory condition is active.

An attack AUTO choice sequence that retires a legal opposing Rear-Guard, captures that exact instance's power, then applies that amount to two chosen friendly units; it also needs the printed +10000 fallback when no card was retired.

An exact-source attack-missed event and once-per-turn consumption; after Counter Blast, stand the source and set its critical and drive to 1 through turn end. Existing events do not expose a general miss trigger, and current modifiers do not represent setting both values to 1.

An attack effect that optionally returns up to two exact-race Rear-Guards, then optionally calls up to two exact-race unit cards from hand to open Rear-Guard Circles. The existing clan operation returns all matching units and is not equivalent.
A Counter-Blast attack effect whose power amount is +5000 per two Quintuplets in memory, with a separate draw condition requiring six distinct Quintuplet names.
On this Vanguard's attack hitting a Vanguard, choose one Quintuplet in the controller's Drop and move that exact card into memory.

At the beginning of the controller's turn, check both seven distinct Quintuplet names and fourteen total Quintuplet cards in memory, then resolve a game-win effect. The current effect set has no win-condition operation.
During the controller's turn, grant all friendly front-row Quintuplet Rear-Guards +2000 for each card in that controller's Drop, gated by six distinct Quintuplet names in memory.

An exact source attack battle-close event, once-per-turn restriction, Counter Blast, stand, and drive reduction by two through turn end. Current drive modification only supports the unrelated positive drive-check path.

abilities.printedText: AUTO: When this unit is placed on VC, look at the top seven cards of your deck, choose up to two <Quintuplet> from among them, reveal them, choose a card from among the revealed cards, put it into hand, put the rest of the revealed cards into memory, and shuffle the deck.
CONT [VC]: If your memory has six or more <Quintuplet> with different card names, when your opponent would call cards from hand to GC, they must call two or more cards at the same time.

AUTO [VC]: When this unit attacks a vanguard, COST [Counter Blast 1], choose one of your opponent’s rear-guards, retire it, choose one of your <Quintuplet> rear-guards, and increase the power of that unit and this unit by the power of the unit retired by this ability. If you did not retire a card, increase power by +10000 instead.

AUTO: When this unit is placed on VC, look at the top seven cards of your deck, choose up to two <Quintuplet> from among them, reveal them, choose a card from among the revealed cards, put it into hand, put the rest of the revealed cards into memory, and shuffle the deck.
CONT [VC]: If your memory has six or more <Quintuplet> with different card names, this unit gets critical +1.
AUTO [VC] 1/Turn: When this unit’s attack does not hit, COST [Counter Blast 1], stand this unit, and increase of decrease its critical and drive to 1 until end of turn.

AUTO: When this unit is placed on VC, look at the top seven cards of your deck, choose up to two <Quintuplet> from among them, reveal them, choose a card from among the revealed cards, put it into hand, put the rest of the revealed cards into memory, and shuffle the deck.
CONT [VC]: During your turn, if your memory has six or more <Quintuplet> with different card names, all of your front row <Quintuplet> get power +10000.

AUTO [VC] 1/Turn: When this unit attacks, COST [Counter Blast 1], choose up to two of your <Quintuplet> rear-guards, return them to hand, choose up to two <Quintuplet> unit cards from your hand, and call them to open RC.

AUTO: When this unit is placed on VC, look at the top seven cards of your deck, choose up to two <Quintuplet> from among them, reveal them, choose a card from among the revealed cards, put it into hand, put the rest of the revealed cards into memory, and shuffle the deck.

AUTO [VC]: When this unit attacks, COST [Counter Blast 1], and this unit gets power +5000 until end of turn for every two <Quintuplet> in your memory. If your memory has six or more <Quintuplet> with different card names, draw a card.
AUTO [VC]: When this unit’s attack hits a vanguard, choose a <Quintuplet> from your drop, and put it into memory.
AUTO [VC]: At the beginning of your turn, if your memory has seven or more <Quintuplet> with different card names and a total of fourteen or more <Quintuplet>, you win the game.

AUTO: When this unit is placed on VC, look at the top seven cards of your deck, choose up to two <Quintuplet> from among them, reveal them, choose a card from among the revealed cards, put it into hand, put the rest of the revealed cards into memory, and shuffle the deck.
CONT [VC]: During your turn, if your memory has six or more <Quintuplet> with different card names, all of your front row <Quintuplet> rear-guards get power +2000 for each card in your drop.
AUTO [VC] 1/Turn: At the end of the battle this unit attacked, COST [Counter Blast 1], stand this unit, and it gets drive -2 until end of turn.
